title: Harry S. Truman once said:
hook: Harry S. Truman once said:
caption:
Harry S. Truman once said:
"In reading the lives of great men, I found that the first victory they won was over themselves."

Think about that for a moment.

Before they conquered territories, built businesses, led nations or achieved extraordinary success, they first conquered something much closer to home: THEMSELVES.

They conquered procrastination. 
They conquered indiscipline. 
They conquered fear.
They conquered the desire for instant gratification. 

And, most importantly, they learned to do what needed to be done, even when it was uncomfortable.

Now, let me bring this closer to you.

title: Talent gets you to the start line. Your mind gets you over the finish line. 🧠🇵🇬
hook: Talent gets you to the start line. Your mind gets you over the finish line. 🧠🇵🇬
caption:
Talent gets you to the start line. Your mind gets you over the finish line. 🧠🇵🇬

Today PNGOC met Michael Esop from the University of Papua New Guinea to talk sports psychology and his Australian Awards projects.

Why does it matter? PNG athletes are naturally talented, but big moments test the mind as much as the body.

Resilience. Emotional control. Self-belief. Motivation. These are skills, and skills can be trained.

And the best support understands our culture, our values and our way of life. That's why growing PNG's own sports psychology expertise matters.
